qualifier: gonad, reproductive tract and pancreatic endocrine lineages
name: Gonadal, reproductive tract and pancreatic endocrine development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, gonad, prostate, uterus/vagina and adrenal development plus pancreatic endocrine progenitor lineages, which together separate the theme from the pancreatic-ductal, mammary-gland and germ-cell/seminiferous confusables.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte proliferation with fibroblast and matrix control
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibroblast-mediated connective tissue repair
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation and regeneration alongside fibroblast migration, apoptosis, myofibroblast differentiation and matrix/collagen deposition, distinguishing it from confusables centred on cardiac hypertrophic adaptation, TGF-beta signalling, matrix degradation or miRNA processing.

qualifier: inherited cytochrome P450 and transporter defects
name: Cholesterol biosynthesis and inherited cytochrome P450 enzyme defects
rationale: Members span mevalonate/isoprenoid and Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell cholesterol synthesis plus defective CYP and related lipid-metabolism enzymes and transporters, which the bile-acid, peroxisomal-lipid and quinone confusables lack.

name: Cobalamin, thiamine, riboflavin and biotin uptake and metabolism
rationale: All members concern transport or metabolism of cobalamin (including its inherited defects), thiamine, riboflavin or biotin, distinguishing it from confusables on coenzyme A, vitamin E, folate/methionine and choline metabolism.

core: Male germ cell and sperm function
name: Germ cell development, sperm function and fertilization
rationale: Members cover germ cell proliferation and migration, spermatid structure (acrosome, manchette, mitochondrial sheath), capacitation, motility, zona pellucida binding and egg activation, unlike confusables centred on meiotic recombination, piRNA/zygotic transition or gonadotropin signalling.

core: Tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: PTK6 and ALK/LTK kinase signaling via PI3K/AKT
rationale: Members are PTK6 signalling events, ALK/LTK signalling and tyrosine autophosphorylation feeding PI3K/AKT and ERK, which distinguishes them from the ERBB- and MET-centred confusables.

name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3 and ALK-family kinase alterations
rationale: All members describe signalling by cancer fusions, amplifications or mutants of FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK or LTK, setting the theme apart from EGFR/ERBB2 cancer-variant and ALK drug-resistance confusables.

name: Monocyte recruitment and activation in inflammatory response
rationale: Members concern monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation, activation and pro-inflammatory cytokines, distinguishing them from confusables on monocyte identity signatures, CCR2/CX3CR1 modules and negative regulation of leukocyte adhesion.

name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stress response and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members cover CRH and ACTH signalling, corticotropin and glucocorticoid secretion and stress/fear responses, which the behavioural, neuropeptide and glucocorticoid-receptor confusables lack.

qualifier: white fat differentiation and triglyceride control
name: White adipocyte differentiation and triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members concern white fat cell differentiation and adipose development (PPARG, LXR targets) together with triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, distinguishing them from brown/beige thermogenesis, PPARA/PGC-1alpha and SREBP-gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: Glomerulus development and filtration barrier
rationale: Members concern glomerular podocyte, mesangial, endothelial and basement membrane development, nephrin interactions and glomerular filtration, unlike confusables on tubule/nephron development and brush border polarity.

name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and pre-rRNA processing
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription elongation, pre-rRNA cleavage, ribosome assembly and MYC target programmes, distinguishing them from Pol I initiation/termination, rRNA modification and mixed BTM confusables.

name: Defensin antimicrobial peptides and mucosal defense against microbes
rationale: Members concern defensins and antimicrobial peptide production, target-cell lysis, mucosal innate immunity and responses to bacteria, symbionts and nematodes, while confusables centre on metal sequestration, neutrophil killing and antifungal responses.

name: Growth hormone and leptin JAK-STAT signaling regulating body growth
rationale: Members cover growth hormone and leptin receptor JAK-STAT signalling, IGF receptor potentiation and regulation of organism growth, distinguishing them from feeding-behaviour, thyroid, prolactin and growth-hormone-secretion confusables.

name: Keratan sulfate metabolism and its inherited defects
rationale: All members concern keratan sulfate biosynthesis, degradation or defective enzymes of its synthesis, distinguishing them from chondroitin, dermatan and heparan sulfate and dystroglycan glycosylation confusables.

name: PTK6 (BRK) tyrosine kinase signaling and its effectors
rationale: Every member is a PTK6 signalling event (activation, expression, downregulation and downstream targets), distinguishing it from MET, ALK/PI3K, Hippo and ERBB confusables.

name: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern synthesis and protein attachment of GPI anchors and biosynthesis of galactosylceramides, gangliosides and glycosphingolipids, unlike confusables on nucleotide-sugar transport, glycolipid transport and protein lipidation.

name: AKT-FOXO regulation of stress resistance and neuronal apoptosis
rationale: Members concern AKT/PI3K control of FOXO localization, acetylation and target transcription together with neuronal death (CDK5, neuron apoptosis), distinguishing them from heat-shock, NRF2, IGF-response and unfolded-protein-response confusables.

name: Cullin neddylation, deneddylation and ubiquitin-dependent protein turnover
rationale: The coherent core is neddylation, COP9 deneddylation and ubiquitin-dependent degradation, with several broad BTM modules attached loosely through ubiquitin/protein turnover, which distinguishes it from transcription, Fanconi and RHOBTB confusables.

name: Neuropeptide control of sleep-wake and innate social behaviors
rationale: Members concern sleep/wake regulation, mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviours and stress behaviour with orexin, relaxin and neuropeptide signalling, distinguishing them from opioid/synaptic neuropeptide and HPA-axis confusables.

name: C-type lectin receptor signaling in antifungal immunity
rationale: Members concern Dectin-1, Dectin-2 family and DC-SIGN signalling, lectin and fungal-molecule responses and IL-23 production, distinguishing them from IL-17 and Th1/dendritic cell confusables.

name: HGF/MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are MET activation, recycling, inhibition and downstream effector events and HGF responses (with the related MST1/RON pathway), distinguishing them from ALK/PI3K, TGF-beta mutant, PTK6 and adhesion confusables.

name: ABCA1-mediated HDL assembly and lipoprotein remodeling
rationale: Members concern ABCA1/apoA-I phospholipid efflux, HDL assembly and HDL/LDL remodeling, while confusables centre on regulation of cholesterol efflux, LXR gene expression and foam cell formation.

name: IFN-gamma signaling and Th1 cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover IFN-gamma signalling and its regulation, MHC induction, IL-12 JAK-STAT signalling and Th1/memory T cell differentiation, distinguishing them from dendritic-cell activation and IL-12/IFN-gamma production confusables.

name: Calcineurin phosphatase signaling and disuse skeletal muscle atrophy
rationale: Members concern calcineurin-NFAT signalling and phosphatase/dephosphorylation regulation together with skeletal muscle atrophy, inactivity and SCF-proteasomal degradation, distinguishing them from cardiac adaptation, myogenesis and muscle growth confusables.
